subject: Problems with the colour bar in legend with scale_fill_gradient2 and geom_polygon

messages.author: e5d5c2a3f407cc6e
messages.subject: Problems with the colour bar in legend with scale_fill_gradient2 and geom_polygon
parts:
Hi All, 

I have a problem with legend 

I have plotted a map using geom_polygon and scale_fill_gradient2. The colour displayed on the map is what I want (blue is value below 0 and red is above). However, on the legend part, the colour bar doesn't appear. I will be grateful if someone can point what I have done wrong. My code for the plot is as follow 


smrmapl <- ggplot(outputData, aes(long,lat, group = group)) + 
  geom_polygon(aes(fill = meanadjsmr), colour = "black")  + labs(x=" ", y=" ") + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) + 
  theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), panel.grid.major=element_blank()) + 
  theme(axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank()) + 
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90")) + 
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12), legend.key = element_rect(fill = F, colour = F))
